[PREFERENCE] User is planning to make a healthy meal for the week and is looking for new recipes.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Boneless chicken breast is an excellent protein choice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested recipes using boneless chicken breast include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Grilled Chicken Fajitas: Marinate chicken breast in lime juice, olive oil, garlic, and spices, grill with bell peppers and onions, serve with whole wheat tortillas and brown rice or quinoa.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Chicken and Avocado Salad: Grill or bake chicken breast, mix with diced avocado, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and feta cheese, top with vinaigrette.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Lemon Rosemary Chicken: Brush chicken breast with lemon zest, olive oil, garlic, and rosemary, bake, serve with roasted vegetables and quinoa or brown rice.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Chicken and Veggie Stir-Fry: Sauté diced chicken breast with vegetables in olive oil and soy sauce, serve over brown rice or cauliflower rice.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Chicken Tacos: Shred or chop cooked chicken breast, season with taco seasoning, serve in tacos with toppings.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Chicken and Mushroom Creamy Pasta: Sauté mushrooms and onions, add cooked chicken breast and low-fat cream, serve over whole wheat pasta.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Chicken and Spinach Stuffed Bell Peppers: Fill bell peppers with cooked chicken breast, spinach, feta cheese, and brown rice, bake until tender.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Chicken Caesar Wrap: Wrap grilled chicken breast in a whole wheat tortilla with romaine lettuce, cherry tomatoes, and Caesar dressing.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. Chicken and Quinoa Bowl: Roast chicken breast with spices, serve over quinoa with roasted vegetables and tzatziki sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 10. Chicken and Veggie Kabobs: Skewer chicken breast and vegetables, grill or bake, serve with quinoa or brown rice and a side salad.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested healthy sides for Grilled Chicken Fajitas include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Roasted Vegetables: Roasted bell peppers, zucchini, and onions.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Cilantro Lime Rice: Brown rice with cilantro and lime juice.
